title: schoenoplectus lacustris subsp. glaucus
intro: Schoenoplectus lacustris subsp. glaucus, commonly known as Glaucous Bulrush, is a type of aquatic plant belonging to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). The plant has been found to have various health benefits, including being used to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. Glaucous Bulrush is known for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
